Seven pieces

Drag the middle to move · Corners rotate in 45° steps

Make your move.

Use all seven pieces to match the silhouette on the top card.

Move

Drag from the middle of a piece.

Rotate

Drag a corner around the center.

Rotation snaps in 45° steps. Select the parallelogram, then use Flip piece to mirror it. Tap draw to reveal a solution, or tap discard to put that puzzle back.

Keyboard controls

Tab to a piece. Arrow keys move it, Q and E rotate it, and F flips the parallelogram. Hold Shift with an arrow key for a larger move.
